'''Joseph Mark "Joe" Garrett''', better known as '''Stampylonghead''', '''Stampylongnose''', '''Stampy Cat''', or simply '''Stampy''', is an English [[YouTube]]r, actor, and author known for his ''[[Minecraft]]'' playthroughs.

== In the ''Minecraft'' franchise ==
{{Expand section|Describe official appearances:
* Appearance in Humble Blockjam Bundle game jam stream: {{Tweet|stampylongnose|796032301285179392}}
* More info on the LCE update trailer build cameos
* Expand on his appearances at MINECON 2015 & 2016
}}
Builds from his ''Stampy's Lovely World'' YouTube series were featured in multiple {{LCE}} update trailers. Additionally, the [[Legacy Console Edition Tutorial]] added in [[TU19]] included his house and the SS Stumpy from that series.

In 2019, to celebrate the culmination of one trillion views on Minecraft content, Stampy made a cameo appearance in [[One Trillion Minecraft Views on YouTube and Counting]].

=== Events ===
In 2015, Stampy was a featured panellist at [[MINECON 2015]].<ref>{{ytl|irXTpn_OSrE|MINECON 2015 Stampy & Friends|Minecraft|July 30, 2015}}</ref>

In the following year he attended [[MINECON 2016]], where he was featured in a panel about {{MCSM}}.<ref>{{ytl|tI-YURvyPbI|MINECON 2016 Minecraft: Story Mode - A TellTale Panel|Minecraft|October 24, 2016}}</ref>

=== ''Minecraft: Story Mode'' ===
{{Main|MCSM:Stampy Cat}}

==== Season One ====
Within the game, he portrays himself in the episode ''{{MCSM|A Portal to Mystery}}'', alongside several other popular creators. His character becomes intertwined with a series of murders connected to the villain the {{MCSM|White Pumpkin}}, where his role in the story can change depending on the player's choices.

==== Season Two ====
He reappears as himself alongside some builds from his ''Lovely World'' series. Being featured in the title screen and in-game, his tower-like structure with a rainbow-striped dome is used as his domestic household in-universe with his Love Garden beside it.

== Trivia ==
* In contrast to other ''Minecraft'' content creators, Stampy doesn't use a custom ''Minecraft'' skin. Instead he uses a skin based on Fidget from ''{{Wikipedia|Dust: An Elysian Tail}}'' which was originally part of the [[Summer of Arcade Skin Pack]] and later re-released in [[Skin Pack 4]], as well as the [[Legacy Skin Pack]].
* Although unofficial to ''[[Minecraft (franchise)|Minecraft]]'', he has partnered with [[4J Studios]] to release the world from his long-time YouTube series ''Stampy's Lovely World'' on the [[Marketplace]].<ref>https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/4j-studios/stampy%E2%80%99s-lovely-world/2cac624e-2f90-4b3c-aa62-6dd0493ad20e</ref>
* In 2018, Stampy set the {{W|Guiness World Record}} for "Fastest time to make and display 10 cakes in Minecraft (PC Edition)" with a time of 3min51s.<ref>{{Citation|url=https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/news/2018/9/youtube-star-stampy-cat-sets-new-minecraft-record-for-gamers-edition-2019-539361|title=YouTube star Stampy Cat sets new Minecraft record for Gamer’s Edition 2019|website=Guiness World Records|author=Connie Suggitt|date=September 7, 2018}}</ref>
